market_question: Will US withdraw from NATO before 2027?
reasoning: US withdrawal from NATO is extremely unlikely before 2027 due to strong bipartisan support in Congress, lack of any formal withdrawal initiative, and the absence of a foreseeable scenario where the US would invoke Article 13. Market pricing at 8.5% far exceeds the realistic probability, which I estimate around 1.5%.
evidence_points: Congress recently passed legislation reinforcing US commitment to NATO, with overwhelming bipartisan majorities.
No US administration or leading presidential candidate has proposed initiating NATO withdrawal.
Trump's 2016-2020 threats never materialized; institutional constraints remain high.
sources_consulted: Recent US Congressional votes on NATO
Political news on US NATO policy
